page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server belonging to the ecs.n2 instance family. It is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced resource profile with 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation for predictable compute performance.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the configuration features zero integrated GPUs and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.n2.7xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for application servers, web serving, and enterprise applications that require consistent CPU performance and moderate memory capacity without the need for specialized hardware accelerators or local SSD storage.

This resource profile makes the ecs.n2.7xlarge suitable for a variety of enterprise workloads, including medium-sized databases, application servers, web serving, and general-purpose business applications that require a balanced ratio of compute and memory without specialized hardware acceleration.
